records.text: The words of Amos that came among nakkarim from Tekoa, which he saw concerning Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
He said: “The Lord spoke from Zion and gave His voice from Jerusalem; the shepherds’ pastures mourned, and Carmel’s summit dried up.”
The Lord said: “For three impieties of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they sawed the pregnant women of those in Gilead with iron saws.
I will send fire into Hazael’s house, and it will devour the foundations of the son of Ader,

and I will shatter Damascus’s bars and destroy inhabitants from the Plain of On. I will cut down a tribe from the men of Harran, and the people of Syria, called by name, will be taken captive,” says the Lord.
Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away from them, because they took Solomon’s captives into captivity, to shut them up in Idumea.
I will send fire upon Gaza’s walls, and it will devour her foundations.
I will destroy inhabitants from Azotus, and a tribe will be removed from Ascalon. I will bring My hand against Accaron, and the remaining foreigners will perish,” says the Lord.
Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Tyre, and for four, I will not turn away from her, because they shut Solomon’s captives up in Idumea and did not remember a covenant of brothers.
I will send fire upon Tyre’s walls, and it will devour her foundations.”

Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Idumea, and for four, I will not turn away from them, because they pursued his brother with a sword; he ravaged a womb upon the earth, seized his shuddering as testimony, and kept his onrush for victory.
I will send fire into Teman, and it will devour the foundations of her walls.”

Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of the sons of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they ripped open the pregnant women of the Gileadites in order to enlarge their borders.
I will kindle fire upon Rabbah’s walls, and it will devour her foundations with shouting on the day of war; she will be shaken on the day of her end.
Her kings will go into captivity, their priests and their rulers together,” says the Lord.
Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they burned the bones of Idumea’s king into lime.
I will send fire upon Moab, and it will devour the foundations of her cities. Moab will die in weakness, with shouting and the sound of a trumpet.
I will destroy the judge from her, and kill all her rulers with him,” says the Lord.

Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of the sons of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they rejected the Lord’s law and did not keep His ordinances. Their vain things, which they made, led them astray—the things their fathers followed.
I will send fire upon Judah, and it will devour Jerusalem’s foundations.”
Thus says the Lord: “For three impieties of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away from him, because they sold a righteous person for silver and a poor person for sandals,

which tread upon the earth’s dust. They struck the heads of the poor with their fists and turned aside the way of the humble; a son and his father went in to the same young slave woman, to profane the name of their God,
and, tying their garments with cords, they made hangings next to the altar, and drank wine from extortions in their God’s house.
But I removed the Amorite from before them, whose height was like a cedar and who was strong as an oak. I removed his fruit above and his roots below.
I brought you up from Egypt’s land and led you around in the wilderness forty years, to inherit the Amorites’ land.
I took some of your sons as prophets and some of your young men for consecration. Are these things not so, sons of Israel?” says the Lord.
“But you gave the consecrated ones wine to drink and commanded the prophets, saying, ‘You must not prophesy!’
Therefore look, I roll beneath you as a wagon full of straw rolls,
and flight will perish from the runner, the mighty one will certainly not maintain his strength, and the fighter will certainly not save his life,
and the archer will certainly not stand, the swift of foot will certainly not be saved, nor will the horseman save his life,
and he will find his heart among powers; the naked one will pursue on that day,” says the Lord.
Hear this word that the Lord spoke against you, house of Israel, and against every tribe I brought up from Egypt’s land, saying:
“You alone have I known among all the earth’s tribes; therefore I will exact judgment upon you for all your sins.”
Will two go together at all unless they make themselves known to one another?
Will a lion roar from its thicket without prey? Will a young lion give its voice from its enclosure at all unless it has seized something?
Will a bird fall upon the ground without a fowler? Will a trap be sprung upon the ground without catching something?
Will a trumpet sound in a city and the people not be alarmed? Will there be calamity in a city that the Lord has not done?
For the Lord God will certainly do no deed unless He reveals His discipline to His servants the prophets.
A lion will roar—and who will not fear? The Lord God has spoken—and who will not prophesy?
Announce to the regions among the Assyrians and to Egypt’s regions: “Gather upon Samaria’s mountain and see the many astonishing things in her midst and the oppression within her!”
“She did not know what would be against her,” says the Lord—those storing injustice and suffering in their regions.
Therefore thus says the Lord God: “Tyre, your land will be desolated all around; he will bring down your strength from you, and your regions will be plundered.”

Thus says the Lord: “As when a shepherd snatches two legs or an earlobe from a lion’s mouth, so the sons of Israel who dwell in Samaria will be snatched out, opposite a tribe, and priests in Damascus.”
“Hear and bear witness to Jacob’s house,” says the Lord God Almighty,
“because on the day I exact judgment upon Israel for its impieties, I will also exact judgment upon Bethel’s altars. The altar’s horns will be demolished and fall upon the ground,
and I will confound and strike the colonnaded house along with the summer house. Ivory houses will perish, and many other houses will be added,” says the Lord.
